pool.note: Ablation và rerank dùng đúng cùng pool C100; reranker không được mở rộng universe ngầm.

latency_budget.note: Mục tiêu theo SG-021; số đo thật thuộc SG-040. Không điền số giả.

oracle_definition.recall_at_100: fraction of relevant docs present in pool top-100 (per-method only)
oracle_definition.recall_full_union: fraction of relevant docs present anywhere in the FULL BM25+TF-IDF union (up to 200 docs); NOT comparable head-to-head with Recall@100
oracle_definition.oracle_ndcg_at_10: nDCG@10 of the ideal rerank restricted to the pool (relevant-in-pool first, linear gain, log2 discount) divided by full IDCG@10
oracle_definition.answerable_rate: fraction of queries with >=1 relevant doc in pool
